title: The big piece of dark rubble falls through the rock
description: The player breaks a block of the Ice Caves' dark rock with a mattock, over a column of ice. The two small pieces of its rubble stop on the ice, but the big one falls straight down through it, in front of it, to the floor of bricks below.
